tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List Platemark image templates with their size and the slots each one takes. Call this first to pick a template and see slot names.

tools.name: render_image
tools.description: Fill a template's slots and get back a finished PNG. Text shrinks to fit its box. Image slots take an https PNG, JPG or GIF URL under 4 MB. Leave a slot out to keep its sample. Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: render_chart
tools.description: Turn numbers into a clean chart PNG: bar, horizontal_bar, stacked_bar, line, area, pie or donut. Returns the image, a link that works for a year (for emails, docs, Slack or markdown) and one-sentence alt text describing the data. Axes, number formatting, colors and labels are handled; pass the data

tools.name: render_invoice
tools.description: Make a professional invoice PDF and get a link to it. Send the line items and rates; Platemark does the math (subtotal, discount, tax, shipping, amount paid, amount due) in exact cents and formats money for the currency. Returns the PDF link, page count and the totals it used. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: render_document
tools.description: Make a PDF of another kind: quote (estimate with valid-until date), receipt (marked Paid), certificate (completion or award, with signatures) or letter (offer letters, notices). Pass the type and its fields; quotes and receipts take the same fields as render_invoice. Returns a PDF link. Costs 2 cred

tools.name: render_video
tools.description: Make an MP4 (up to 90 seconds) from scenes: each scene is a filled image template or an https photo, shown for some seconds with a slow zoom or pan, joined by fades, with optional music. Returns a job id at once; call video_status with it until the status is done (usually 15 to 60 seconds) to get th

tools.name: video_status
tools.description: Status of a render_video job: queued, rendering, done (with the MP4 link, kept 30 days) or failed (credits refunded).

tools.name: create_account
tools.description: Make a free Platemark account (100 credits a month for images, PDFs and video, small watermark) and return its API key. The key is shown once; tell the user to save it and add it to this server's Authorization header.

tools.name: account_status
tools.description: Plan and credits left for the connected key. Call it before a batch of renders to check there are enough credits.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_account" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: render_image · Private data: render_document, create_account · Public sink: render_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: render_image · Private data: render_document, create_account · Public sink: render_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_account" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Make a free Platemark account (100 images a month, small watermark) and return its API key. The key is shown once; tell the user to save it and add it to this server's Authorization header." → after: "Make a free Platemark account (100 credits a month for images, PDFs and video, small watermark) and return its API key. The key is shown once; tell the user to save it and add it to this server's Authorization header."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
